summary: The milestone completed 11 experiments in 10.5 minutes. Five experiments were compute-bound, and the longest listed compute-bound experiment took 5 minutes. Compute-bound GPU idle was false.

slowest_experiments.experiment: V537 exact-path adversarial capstone using fail-closed terminal classification
Three-family raw-code envelope canary before any new pool or seed stream
Post-V537-marker SOTA delta plus staged-roadmap scope audit
Single ARC slot: leave-one-game-out shadow generalization of the frozen task-awa
Fail-closed terminal-artifact contract after V536 bootstrap-only completions

bottlenecks_identified: The three-family raw-code envelope canary was the longest listed compute-bound experiment at 5 minutes. The data does not contain phase timings, so it does not identify the cause.
The synthesis-only capstone also took 5 minutes. Its lack of GPU use is correct behavior and is not a GPU bottleneck.
The GPU report is a single snapshot without experiment or model-count links. It cannot measure GPU efficiency across compute-task lifetimes.
no data available this milestone for concurrent multi-model execution or DualGPURunner engagement.
improvements_suggested: Record load, inference, wait, and artifact-write timings for each experiment.
Attach GPU utilization samples to the active experiment and record the model count and selected runner.
When at least two independent model jobs are ready, place them on separate GPUs. Keep single-model jobs on the normal single-GPU path.
Report concurrent multi-model windows so the conductor can detect a missed DualGPURunner selection.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add per-phase timers to the compute canary and synthesis capstone paths.
Persist task-linked GPU, model-count, and runner-selection telemetry.
Schedule independent model jobs on separate GPUs when concurrent work exists.
meta_reflection: The timing order identifies where to measure, but it does not explain why the longest tasks took 5 minutes. A savings estimate above zero needs measured phase costs or a timed scheduling comparison.
